name: Dried buffalo meat
summary: Black Thái buffalo dried in the kitchen smoke and served to guests, numbing and hot from mắc khén and sweet from the meat.
taste: Numbing and hot from mắc khén, sweet from the meat, with the smoke of the kitchen.
howToEat: Eat it as a meat with the meal, or buy a pack to carry home.
where: Đồng Văn market, or from a household.
seoTitle: Dried buffalo meat in Dong Van — thit trau gac bep
seoDescription: Thịt trâu gác bếp is Black Thái buffalo dried in the kitchen smoke, numbing and hot from mắc khén and sweet from the meat.
